Title: Senior Data Scientist (Optimization & Machine Learning)
Description:
About Justera Group

Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose-driven, well-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in Linear Programming (LP) and Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) to develop, maintain, and scale production-grade optimization solutions. This role requires a solid foundation in optimization, analytics, statistics, and machine learning, along with the ability to build robust, production-ready data science solutions in a cloud environment.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Python developer who writes clean, modular, and maintainable code, possesses strong SQL skills, and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges.

Key Responsibilities:


Maintain, optimize, and enhance existing optimization models by identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing scalable solutions.
Develop, deploy, monitor, and maintain production-grade optimization and machine learning solutions in a cloud environment.
Build and improve data preparation, transformation, and aggregation pipelines while integrating new data sources to enrich model performance.
Analyze model outputs and communicate insights and recommendations to business stakeholders.
Translate business requirements into technical solutions and maintain clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.
Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Product Managers, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Implement and support MLOps best practices, including deployment, monitoring, automation, and model lifecycle management.
Perform ad hoc data analysis and create visualizations to support data-driven decision-making.
Ensure solution reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency through continuous monitoring and performance improvements.


Requirements:


Strong experience with Discrete Optimization, including Linear Programming (LP), Integer Programming (IP), and Mixed Integer Programming (MIP).
Proven experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions in production cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Advanced Python programming skills with experience writing clean, modular, testable, and production-ready code.
Strong SQL skills for data manipulation, transformation, and analysis.
Hands-on experience with MLOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience building scalable data wrangling, transformation, and aggregation pipelines.
Familiarity with dbt for data transformation workflows.
Experience working in Agile, cross-functional environments.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to thrive in complex, fast-paced, and evolving business environments.


What We Offer:


A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

Title: Computational Biology Scientist – Moleculent Applications Team
Description:
Are you passionate about transforming complex spatial biology data into actionable insights? Do you thrive in a cross-functional environment bridging experimental and computational teams? Moleculent is looking for an experienced Computational Biology Scientist with Immunology knowledge to drive and evolve our Applications and Fee-for-Service (FFS) initiatives. Join us to contribute to cutting-edge technology that unveils new perspectives on human biology!

Moleculent is on an exciting mission to map cell communication at the molecular level in tissue, aiming to unlock radical new insights into human biology. This is a chance to join a focused and dedicated team with extensive experience in building successful life science companies and products.

This is a permanent position based in Solna, Stockholm, with the possibility to work remotely.

We welcome your application, but please note that interviews will be conducted in August!

Job Description

As a Computational Biology Scientist, you will play a key role in driving data analysis workflows for customer and internal validation projects. You will take ownership of project design, biological interpretation, and stakeholder communication, working closely with wet-lab scientists, the Applications Team Lead, and R&D to ensure high-quality, reliable data insights.

Key responsibilities:


Design and interpret analysis strategies to support application development and pilot studies.
Execute image preprocessing, cell segmentation, and spatial metrics extraction using established pipelines.
Compile and visualize results into standardized reports for internal use and customer delivery.
Collaborate on refining methods, troubleshooting, and prototyping new analysis metrics.
Ensure data traceability and compliance with Moleculent's data packaging standards.


Qualifications

To fit this role well, you should hold an MSc or PhD in computational biology, bioinformatics, image analysis, spatial omics, or a related field. It’s a strong advantage if you have done a postdoc in a relevant field. Fluency in both written and spoken English, along with strong computer skills, is essential. Experience in clearly and effectively presenting data—both in writing and in oral presentations—is a key requirement.


Proficiency in Python and spatial single-cell analysis, with the ability to design, execute, and interpret analysis workflows for complex datasets.
A solid understanding of immunology is important, as our data closely relates to immune cell populations, marker panels, and tissue-based immune profiling.
Experience working directly with customers—whether through pilot studies, fee-for-service delivery, or technical support—is highly valued in this role.
Experience working across R&D, product, and commercial functions is a plus.
Skilled in summarizing insights for cross-functional teams.


MOLECULENT

We believe that our understanding of the molecular basis of human biology, in health and disease will increase radically in the coming ten years. This will lead to a vast improvement in therapies, and diagnostics, and a new, fundamental understanding of our own biology.

Moleculent is on a mission to develop technology-enabled products that leverage new insights into the molecular foundation of human biology.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer - Energy Optimization
Description:
Residential heating is one of Europe’s largest sources of CO₂ emissions, while energy prices remain unpredictable for many households. At Aira, we’re on a mission to change that. Founded in 2022 and now employing more than 800 people, we develop and install clean energy solutions—including heat pumps, solar panels, and battery systems—powered by intelligent technology that helps homes operate more efficiently.

Our goal is simple: to help households reduce both their carbon footprint and their energy costs.

With headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Poland, and hubs across the UK, Germany, and Italy, Aira is rapidly scaling to bring clean energy technology to 5 million homes by 2034.

About The Role 

In the Energy Optimization team, we build optimization and machine learning systems that help control when heat pumps run, when batteries charge or discharge, and when it makes sense to export energy to the grid. We are also building new flexibility capabilities by coordinating fleets of homes to support the grid when it matters most.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join this product team. You’ll work on models and systems that turn messy real-world signals into reliable decisions for customers’ homes. This includes building and improving forecasting and optimization models, productionising them, monitoring their performance, and iterating based on real-world outcomes.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other teams to ship customer-facing intelligence that is reliable, understandable, and valuable. We value clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

If you enjoy turning ML models into production systems that create measurable customer impact, we would like to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Doing



Build and improve ML and optimization models that power customer-facing energy optimization features.
Work on time-series forecasting, scheduling, and decision models for heat pumps, batteries, solar, tariffs, weather, and customer behaviour.
Productionise and own models end-to-end, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and iteration based on real-world outcomes.
Run experiments on real customer systems, evaluate impact, and turn results into product decisions.
Contribute to initiatives from discovery to production impact, helping define success metrics and align with stakeholders.
Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, explaining trade-offs, uncertainty, model behaviour, and what is good enough to ship.



What You’ll Bring To The Role



Experience building ML, data, or optimization systems that are used in real-world products.
Good programming skills in Python and software engineering fundamentals.
Experience taking models beyond notebooks, including evaluation, testing, deployment, or monitoring.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Comfort working with real-world data, including ambiguity, imperfect signals, and changing requirements.
A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset: you care about measurable customer impact, not model complexity for its own sake.
Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate well in cross-functional teams.



Bonus points if you have



Experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand response, or flexibility.
Experience with constrained optimization, control systems, or physical systems modelling.



What is in it for you?



Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.



At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

  • Comfort working with real-world data, including ambiguity, imperfect signals, and changing requirements.

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate well in cross-functional teams.

  • Experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand response, or flexibility.
  • Experience with constrained optimization, control systems, or physical systems modelling.


What is in it for you?


  • Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
  • Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
  • Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
  • Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.

We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

Title: Data Science Intern
Description:
Refino söker en Data Science Intern




Refino är ett snabbväxande fintech-bolag inom refinansieringskrediter. Vi ger privatpersoner möjligheten att samla sina lån, sänka sina kostnader och ta kontroll över sin ekonomi igen, en riktig omstart för tusentals hushåll. Bakom kulisserna är vi datadrivna in i minsta detalj, där varje beslut backas av siffror. Vi växer snabbt och du ser din analys landa direkt i verkligheten.

Analysera stora datamängder i BigQuery och andra dataverktyg
Identifiera mönster, trender och affärsinsikter

Ta fram datadrivna rekommendationer för produkt och affär
Arbeta med datakvalitet och strukturering
Utföra ad hoc-analyser och stötta beslutsfattande med data

Du studerar inom data science, statistik, ekonomi, teknik eller liknande, och känner dig hemma i SQL och gärna Python eller R. Har du nosat på BigQuery, dashboards eller visualiseringsverktyg är det ett plus – men det viktigaste är analytisk höjd och driv.




Praktikplatsen är på plats hos oss i centrala Stockholm. Upplägg och period löser vi tillsammans.

Title: King's AI/ML & Data Science Talent Pool
Description:
Craft:

Data, Analytics & Strategy

Job Description:

Join King’s AI/ML & Data Science Talent Pool!

At King, we’re always interested in connecting with talented people across AI, Machine Learning, Data Science and Analytics who are passionate about using data and technology to create better experiences for millions of players.

Whether you’re an Associate, Mid-level, Senior, Principal or Lead Data Scientist, AI/ML Engineer, Research Engineer or Product Analyst, we’d love to hear from you. By joining our Talent Pool, you’ll be considered for future opportunities across our game teams and central AI/ML and Data Science teams. If your background aligns with a role, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will get in touch to discuss it with you.

What We’re Typically Looking For

Our teams work across areas including applied AI research, player behaviour modelling, personalisation, recommendations, experimentation, decision automation, game and product analytics, content optimisation, forecasting and production ML systems.

While every role requires a different combination of skills, we often look for people with experience in:


Applying data science, machine learning, statistics or analytics to solve player, product or business challenges.
Developing models, experiments, analyses or data products that improve player experience, personalisation, content, decision-making or business performance.
Taking work from exploration and prototyping through to implementation, production or measurable product impact.
Building or working with reliable data and ML pipelines, evaluation approaches and scalable systems.
Bringing expertise in one or more areas such as machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, optimisation, deep learning, reinforcement learning, generative AI or data visualisation.
Using relevant tools and technologies for your field. Depending on the role, these might include Python, SQL, Spark, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, cloud platforms, dashboards, experimentation platforms or ML pipelines. We don’t expect candidates to have experience with all of these.
Collaborating with Engineering, Product, Game Design, UX and other disciplines to turn opportunities into practical, player-focused solutions.
Communicating complex ideas clearly through analysis, documentation, model evaluations, prototypes, dashboards or presentations.


We welcome people from both academia and industry; from PhD students and early-career professionals to experienced specialists and technical leaders.

Your experience might come from gaming, consumer technology, entertainment, e-commerce, fintech, advertising, research or another data-rich environment. What matters most is your curiosity, collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for solving complex problems and delivering meaningful impact.

Why King?

At King, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to games and experiences enjoyed by millions of players around the world. You could work with large-scale data, explore emerging technologies, help bring models into production or use analytics to inform decisions that directly affect our players.

Our AI/ML, Data Science and Analytics teams work in collaborative, cross-functional environments where curiosity, experimentation, technical excellence and practical impact are encouraged.

Whether you’re passionate about applied AI research, ML engineering, product analytics, experimentation or scalable ML systems, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution while continuing to develop your craft.

Interested?

Submit your profile to our Talent Pool!

Every profile submitted is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If your skills and experience align with the types of AI/ML, Data Science or Analytics opportunities we hire for, we’ll add your profile to our Talent Pool and may reach out if a suitable opportunity becomes available.

If we don’t believe your background currently aligns with these opportunities, we’ll let you know and won’t progress your profile into the Talent Pool at this time. You’re always welcome to apply for other opportunities at King that match your skills and experience.

We appreciate your interest in King and look forward to connecting with you if the right opportunity arises.

About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Har du flera års erfarenhet och teknisk kompetens inom Data Science-projekt? Vi söker dig som är en passionerad och erfaren Data Scientist, där du blir en del av vårt satsningsområde där målsättningen är att bli ledande. Våra kunder har ett stort behov av automatisering genom intelligent automation och dataanalys, och vi behöver din expertis! Vill du forma framtidens digitala samhälle och ständigt utvecklas? Då har vi utmaningen för dig!

Din roll

Våra kunder genomgår en digital förändringsresa där du som Data Scientist kommer att ha en nyckelroll. I rollen som Data Scientist kommer du att arbeta med allt från externa faktorer, programmering, dataanalys, API:er, backend och leverans, till att leda projekt och säkerställa hög prestanda i skala.

Som konsult på Atea är du en drivkraft bakom din egen, Ateas och våra kunders framgång. Konsultrollen erbjuder spännande och utmanande uppdrag, på egen hand eller i team med andra kollegor. Du får möjlighet att möta nya människor och kontexter där du ansvarar för att driva innovativa projekt framåt, bidra med din expertis och identifierar nya möjligheter där både du och Atea kan skapa värde för våra kunder.

Du kommer att vara en del av vårt affärsområde Information Management som omfattar strategi, arkitektur, information & data analytics (AI, BI, RPA och IoT), verksamhetsutveckling, förändringsledning, it-styrning, projektledning samt informations- och cybersäkerhet.

Rollen som Data Scientist på Atea erbjuder:


Möjlighet att leda och driva spännande data science-projekt
En dynamisk arbetsmiljö där din goda affärsförståelse och starka kommunikationsförmåga, både internt och externt, kommer till sin rätt
En plattform för att utveckla dina interpersonella färdigheter och optimera prestanda genom kod- och dataflödesoptimeringar



Joanna Nordlund, Konsultchef på Atea, kommer att vara din närmste chef i rollen. Du kommer ingå ett närmsta team på tio drivna och ansvarstagande kollegor som jobbar tätt tillsammans och alltid ställer upp för varandra. Du kommer även jobba tätt med andra team inom området på Atea. Inom teamet är det högt i tak och prestigelöst och vi har en bred kunskap som består av både juniora och seniora personer.

Vem är du?

Vi tror på dig och dina personliga egenskaper, som är viktiga för att lyckas och trivas hos oss. Du är drivande och resultatinriktad, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med lätt för att anpassa dig till nya förhållanden. Du är kommunikativ, skapar goda relationer och har ett affärsmässigt fokus där du förstår innebörden att leverera hög klass på service mot våra kunder. Med god erfarenhet är du självgående inom området och du strävar efter att utvecklas inom området.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har:


Relevant akademisk utbildning inom IT, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap, matematik, fysik, kemi eller motsvarande.
Flera års erfarenhet som Data Scientist eller i en liknande roll.
Hög kompetens inom statistisk modellering och analys.
Djup förståelse för sambandet mellan verkliga faktorer, modellparametrar och tolkning av modellresultat.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python.
Erfarenhet av Machine Learning och AI-lösningar.
Erfarenhet av att utveckla och produktionssätta datadrivna lösningar.
Stark affärsförståelse och förmåga att omsätta avancerad analys till verksamhetsnytta.
God kommunikativ förmåga och kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.



Meriterande:


Erfarenhet av generativ AI och LLM-baserade lösningar.
Erfarenhet av analys och prognostisering med stöd av AI.
Erfarenhet av data engineering.
Erfarenhet av produktionssättning av ML-modeller.
Erfarenhet av datamodellering och utveckling av datalager.
Erfarenhet av API-utveckling, SQL, HTML och JavaScript.
Erfarenhet av Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab eller liknande utvecklingsverktyg.



Om Atea

Visste du att Atea är den ledande leverantören av it-infrastruktur i Norden och Baltikum? I Sverige är vi runt 2700 medarbetare fördelade på 35 kontor runt om i hela landet. Vår styrka ligger i vår kombination av lokal närvaro, vårt omfattande och heltäckande erbjudande samt alla våra specialister. Tillsammans med våra kunder och partners bygger vi Sverige med it och förbättra vardagen för skolbarn, lärare, äldre, sjukvård och näringslivet. Hos oss får du vara en del av världens mest hållbara it-servicebolag, där vi är med och påskyndar omställningen mot en mer hållbar it-värld.

På Atea blir du en del av en vardag och en kultur som präglas av framåtanda, laganda och humor. Vi har en vision om att vara "The Place to Be" – en plats där alla växer och trivs, med kollegor som bryr sig om dig, om kunderna och om samhället.

Kontakt & mer information

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Joanna Nordlund, konsultchef, via joanna.nordlund@atea.se. Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Annie Davnert, Talent Acquisition Partner, via annie.davnert@atea.se. Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Under sommaren kan svarstiden bli längre än normalt på grund av semesterperiod.

I den här rekryteringen kan arbetspsykologiska tester användas som en del av urvalsprocessen. Som en kvalitativ del i vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll för vissa av våra tjänster, detta för att öka kännedomen om dig som vår framtida medarbetare.

Vår arbetssätt är flexibelt - Vi tror på att ge möjlighet till flexibilitet i vardagen men merparten av arbetstiden som vi inte spenderar hos en kund eller på resande fot utgår vi från kontoret, som är vår primära arbetsplats.

Atea vill vara The Place To Be, den självklara platsen, för alla människor då vi värdesätter och jobbar aktivt med mångfald och inkludering.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Den här rekryteringen hanteras av oss på Atea och vi undanber oss därför samtal och mail från rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag.

Title: Research Scientist, Fixed-Term
Description:
Spotify has more than 600M listeners in more than 180 markets around the world, who use our music, podcast, and audiobook services to find what delights, entertains, educates, and informs them. Personalization is a high impact organization that provides the technology to serve them what they expect to find, to help them explore and find new things to enjoy, and to suggest things they might not be aware of that they would like.

You'll be working as part of the Speech team at Spotify, which develops state-of-the-art technologies powering applications such as the AI DJ, generative advertisements, and other audio experiences across the platform. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with engineers and researchers on the team while driving research that pushes the boundaries of our current capabilities in speech synthesis, speech recognition, and audio generation helping define the next generation of audio interaction at Spotify.

Our team focuses on ensuring that the foundations of Spotify's speech technologies are at or above the state of the art. We maintain strong ties both internally to product groups and externally to the research community, and we actively encourage publishing at top venues.

What You'll Do


Conduct research in one or more areas of speech technology, such as text-to-speech synthesis, automatic speech recognition, neural audio codecs, or voice conversion.

Title: Software Engineer within eHealth
Description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

The position

Do you want to fundamentally change how open platforms of the future will play a role in healthcare and welfare improvement? Do you want to work with complex information systems designed for innovation, interoperability and with requirements to scale? Do you want to work with products on an international market?

If so, then we have got a fantastic opportunity for you to become a member of our Cambio Platform team. Our vision is to create a new open platform as a foundation for a future eHealth ecosystem. A fundamental part of an ecosystem that is driven by the value of information and the enabling of innovation for Cambio, other vendors as well as the business themselves to deliver value to everyone from clinicians to citizens. A key part of this platform is the OpenEHR Clinical Data Repository (CDR), which provides a standards-based foundation for managing, sharing, and evolving clinical data across products, services, and ecosystems.

We are now looking for a senior software engineer to be part of our team, where you will play a key role in shaping how we deliver reliable, scalable, and efficient solutions across the company — with a strong focus on building and evolving our OpenEHR-based Clinical Data Repository (CDR) as a core component of the Cambio Platform.

What You’ll Do


Develop, test, and evolve backend services for the Cambio CDR product
Design and operate services in containerized environments
Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and provide technical expertise to the team
Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve services in production
Collaborate on architecture, reliability, and security decisions


We Offer


Join a passionate group of experts working with modern technologies and industry best practices, where collaboration leads to real impact
A dynamic environment full of new challenges and a broad technology stack to keep your skills sharp and your work exciting
Technical freedom to influence the tools and technologies you work with, empowering you to craft the best solutions


About You

We believe that you are passionate about solving technical challenges and have effective communication skills when cooperating cross teams. You thrive in a changing environment and independently drive your own and your team's work forward.

At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care, and Together—values we believe are important to both our work and our people. It’s important to us that you recognize and identify with these values.

Requirements 


Strong experience from Java or Kotlin programming languages
Strong understanding of service-oriented architectures and microservices
Comfortable using modern AI tools as a natural part of your development workflow.
Understanding of cyber security and secure software development principles such as token-based authentication, identity federation, and Zero Trust architectures.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English


It's a bonus if you have


Experience working with OpenEHR, clinical information models, or healthcare interoperability standards
Experience from building and setting up test automation
Experience working according to DevOps/DevSecOps principles


__________________________________________________________________

Place of employment: Stockholm or Linköping

Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)

Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period

Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.


We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As a Data Scientist at Legora you will turn data into decisions. You'll sit close to the business, taking questions end-to-end: shaping the metric, modelling the data in dbt, running the analysis, and making the recommendation. You'll pull in new data sources when you need to, but the underlying instrumentation and platform belong to our data engineering team. Insights are useful; impact is what we hire for.

We're an AI-first data team. We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

There's no single profile we hire for. Some of us are strongest at data modelling and analytics engineering, some at experimentation and causal inference, some at machine learning, some at stakeholder influence. You'll likely be excellent at one or two of these and competent across the rest. That's the bar.

We're a Small, Centralised Team Supporting The Whole Company, Hiring For The Person, Not The Seat. Depending On Your Strengths And Where We Have The Biggest Gap When You Join, You Could Be Embedded Primarily With


Product: instrumentation, feature adoption, user behaviour, A/B testing, shaping the roadmap with PMs and designers.
Finance & RevOps: ARR, NRR, forecasting, board reporting, pricing analytics across a 40-country footprint, and unit economics for an AI-native product.
Growth & Marketing: acquisition funnels, attribution, campaign measurement, lifecycle analytics, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.
GTM & Customer Success: pipeline analytics, customer health, expansion signals, and retention drivers in a category that didn't exist three years ago.


You'll partner directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM, most of whom are unusually data-fluent and will happily open a SQL editor with you. Your work will directly influence how we prioritise, how we sell, how we price, and how we build.

What You Will Be Doing


Partner with stakeholders across Product, Finance, GTM, Growth, and beyond to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Define the metrics that matter, design the experiments or analyses that test them, and measure the impact of what we ship.
Conduct deep-dive analyses on the questions that move the business, and proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet.
Model the data you need for your work in dbt, pulling in new sources when necessary, and partner closely with data engineering on anything that needs to scale beyond your immediate use case.
Build dashboards and reporting that scale beyond you, so the company can answer its own questions where possible.
Help shape how the data team operates as we scale: standards, tooling, ways of working.


What You'll Need


Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.
Solid grasp of data modelling and what it takes to build analytical work that is reliable and trusted.
Excellent communication skills and the confidence to influence decisions through data storytelling, including pushing back when the data doesn't support what someone wants to do.
Genuine depth in at least one of the following, with competence across the rest and curiosity to grow:
Data modelling and analytics engineering (dbt, dimensional modelling, semantic layers, self-service)
Experimentation and causal inference (A/B test design, quasi-experiments, statistical rigour)
Machine learning and applied data science (forecasting, prediction, segmentation, evaluation)
Product analytics and metric design (funnels, cohorts, adoption frameworks, North Star metrics)

Nice to have


Experience in a product-led or SaaS environment, ideally B2B.
Hands-on experience with our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Dagster.
Prior experience as an early data hire at a fast-growing company, i.e. you've built the muscle, not inherited it.


Most Importantly, You Are Someone Who


"Gets stuff done" and understands building a $10bn company isn't always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours.
Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren't always clear and processes are few.
Is genuinely domain-curious. You don't need to have worked on every part of a business, but you should be excited to.


Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!




Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities




We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.




The role:

As a Senior ML Engineer, you will be working hands-on to optimise the training and deployment of ML models to be quick and cost-efficient. You will also be at the forefront of putting our ML models on mobile devices to enhance data privacy and customer experience. To achieve this, you will need to collaborate with teams across Truecaller to establish best practices and tools for efficient ML model development and deployment, particularly on mobile platforms. You will be expected to help Truecaller reach and remain at the cutting edge of ML training and deployment, and to explore new frontiers such as federated learning.




What you will do

Understand the current and future needs of developers and the organisation, and create a roadmap with your manager for meeting those needs.
Work with teams across Truecaller, enabling them to deploy models to production quickly and cost-effectively.
Work hands-on with teams throughout Truecaller to optimise ML models for mobile devices.
Be the go-to expert for developing models for mobile devices as well as deploying them.
Staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in ML Engineering, especially ML on mobile phones, and driving continuous innovation throughout Truecaller.




What you bring in

Degree in computer science or equivalent
5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with a focus on deploying ML models in production environments.
A strong understanding and experience to optimise feature engineering, model training, and model deployment.
Hands-on experience deploying ML models on mobile devices (e.g., TensorFlow Lite, Core ML, ONNX Runtime Mobile).
Strong understanding of machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX) and their deployment on mobile platforms.
Understanding of both Android and iOS development and how that impacts ML model deployment and usage.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams and disciplines.
A customer-focused mindset.
Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English.

.

What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:

A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.




Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.




Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/




Sounds like a great opportunity?




We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.




We only accept applications in English.

We are growing and looking for a hands-on bioinformatician to join our data science team and take end-to-end ownership of analysis service delivery. 




The Role 

You will work closely with the Bioinformatics Lead and across R&D and commercial teams to run our analysis service projects from raw data to customer delivery. This is a broad, hands-on role that spans bioinformatics analysis, pipeline and R package development, server operations, and direct customer interaction. No two days will look the same. 




What You Will Work On:




Analysis service delivery 

Run end-to-end service projects: from FASTQ to QC, analysis, and data delivery 
Prepare and deliver customer data packages through our secure data delivery system 
Support study design discussions and pre-project scoping with the commercial team 
Troubleshoot customer-facing pipeline errors and coordinate resolutions 




Pipeline and R package development 

Extend and maintain the Snakemake pipeline, including adding standard ChIP-seq QC metrics 
Contribute to the planned migration to Nextflow (nf-core framework) 
Develop and document new functions in EpigenicR, our R package 
Write tests and maintain documentation to keep the package production-ready 




Server and infrastructure 

Manage day-to-day operations on our HPC server  
Administer user environments, conda/container setups, and job scheduling 
Diagnose and resolve server issues
Support onboarding of new team members onto the compute infrastructure 




What We Are Looking For:




Required 

PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, or a related field; or MSc with at least 2 years of relevant industry or research experience 
Solid hands-on experience with ChIP-seq data analysis: alignment, peak calling, QC, and downstream interpretation 
Proficiency in R and Python; experience writing functions or packages others can use 
Experience with workflow managers such as Snakemake or Nextflow 
Familiarity with Linux/HPC environments, SLURM, and conda or container-based setups (Docker/Singularity)
Version control with Git, including repository organisation and documentation
Ability to work independently and manage several concurrent projects 




Nice to have 

Experience with nf-core pipelines or contributing to community bioinformatics tools 
Familiarity with epigenomic data types beyond ChIP-seq (ATAC-seq, WGBS, cfDNA/methylation) 
Experience with cloud or cold storage infrastructure (e.g. S3) 
Background in customer-facing or commercial scientific support 
Knowledge of R package development best practices (e.g. roxygen2) 




What We Offer:

A central role in a growing data science team at an early-stage biotech with real scientific impact 
Broad, varied work spanning analysis, development, infrastructure, and customer collaboration 
Close collaboration with R&D, commercial, and leadership teams 
A technical environment built on modern tools: Snakemake/Nextflow, R, cloud delivery 
Opportunity to contribute to AI-assisted analysis and large-cohort database development 
Flexible hybrid working arrangement based in Stockholm 




How to Apply: Please visit our website and complete the submission form in the job listing.




Location: Hybrid (Stockholm)




Start date: As soon as possible




Deadline: August 14th, 2026

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.

We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

The Role

Are you passionate about advancing the data science craft and leading work that drives measurable business impact across teams?

Join Mentimeter as a Senior Data Scientist, where you will play a pivotal role in shaping how data science supports our Enterprise go-to-market motions and helps Mentimeter make better strategic decisions.

Data is central to how Mentimeter succeeds. At Mentimeter, the Catalyst department is on a mission to realise our company strategy and drive innovation, growth, and impact throughout the company by using data, automations and generative AI. In this role, you will collaborate with cross functional teams, senior stakeholders, and company leaders to identify high impact opportunities and turn them into data science solutions that improve decision making, customer outcomes, and revenue growth.

You will join the Revenue Analytics team, working at the intersection of analytics, data science, revenue operations, and business. Your work will not only influence team and functional outcomes, but also contribute to broader cross functional goals across our go-to-market organisation.

What You’ll Do


Lead data science initiatives and workstreams for our Enterprise go-to-market motions, from opportunity discovery and problem framing through to delivery, adoption, and impact measurement.
Design, build, and productionise machine learning models and data products such as predictive scoring, clustering, forecasting, segmentation, recommendation, and prioritisation models.
Identify and shape high impact opportunities across retention, engagement, revenue growth, sales efficiency, customer lifecycle, and go-to-market performance.
Partner with Revenue Operations, Product Analytics, Analytics Engineers as well as senior business stakeholders and company leaders to align priorities and drive impact.
Set and evolve data science craft standards, including best practices for modelling, code quality, deployment, monitoring, documentation, automation, and responsible use of AI.
Mentor and guide data scientists, analysts, and cross functional partners, helping raise the quality and impact of data science work across the function.
Communicate recommendations and complex analyses in a way that influences decisions across different levels of the organisation.



We believe you have


A minimum of 8+ years of relevant experience in data science, analytics, machine learning, or a closely related field.
A proven track record of leading data science projects or workstreams end-to-end, including problem framing, stakeholder alignment, technical delivery, adoption, and impact measurement.
Deep expertise in data science methodologies, with strong proficiency in Python, SQL, machine learning, statistics, and applied modelling.
Experience using AI tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar to improve productivity, automation, and delivery quality.
Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect data science opportunities to strategic business objectives across sales, marketing, product, revenue operations, customer engagement, retention, or growth.
Experience navigating ambiguous or complex business problems, identifying the right analytical approach, and driving alignment across multiple teams.
Strong software and ML engineering practices, including git, code reviews, testing, versioning, monitoring, documentation, and writing performant, maintainable code for production use.
Experience setting or improving technical standards, best practices, reusable patterns, or ways of working within a data science, analytics, or engineering team.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in influencing senior stakeholders priorities and decisions through clear narratives, visualisations, and recommendations with clear business impact.
A track record of mentoring others, providing technical guidance, and fostering a culture of high standards, continuous learning, and collaboration.
Experience collaborating closely with data engineers or analytics engineers on data pipelines, model deployment, monitoring, and scalable data foundations.



Nice to have


Familiarity with modern data tools such as Snowflake, Hex, dbt, or similar.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
Experience working in a SaaS environment, especially with enterprise go-to-market, revenue, customer lifecycle, product usage, or retention data.
Experience influencing company-level priorities through data science, analytics, or strategic insight work.



Not required


Swedish is not required (as daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ different nationalities)
A traditional cover letter is not required as part of your application



📍 Location:

This is primarily an onsite role located at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, with a hybrid approach and ability to work from home up to twice per week.

Please note that we do not offer visa relocation sponsorship for this position.

💡Our Recruitment Process


Introduction interview
Competence interview, including a live case.
Personality & Logical ability test
Culture interview
References & Offer



Compensation

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.

The salary range for this role is SEK 70,000–SEK 86,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.

Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm.

What Mentimeter Can Offer

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.


AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.



AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Culture at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique energy trading portfolios on the market.




We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?




Job Mission 🚀

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will help accelerate Data Science at Tibber by bridging the gap between advanced data science and robust production systems. You'll play a key role in building predictive data models that increase our metric of savings per kWh.




What You'll Do ✅

Lead the ML platform build. Own the direction of our ML infrastructure: model registries, versioning, monitoring, drift detection and automated retraining, and take it from good to great. This is the core of the role, especially in your first year.




Ship models that move the metric. Develop and deploy forecasting, optimization and personalization models that plug straight into live products like Smart Charging and dynamic pricing.




Strengthen the impact chain. We evaluate every data science service against clear goals. You'll help us take the next step: connecting model quality all the way to realized savings per kWh, through counterfactual evaluation and decision-quality metrics.




Raise the bar with your peers. Review code, sharpen best practices and shape how a senior team works with LLM and agentic AI tools, as colleagues not students.




Own end-to-end delivery. Drive the full lifecycle from problem framing and data sourcing to production deployment and continuous improvement.




What We're Looking For⚡

You are driven by impact, enjoy fast-paced environments, and thrive when given autonomy. You've built an ML platform before and know how to go beyond models that work in a notebook to a system a team can trust.




We Believe You'll Be a Great Fit If You

Have a proven track record of developing production-grade ML platforms with drift detection, model registries and CI/CD workflows, and can point to teams that shipped faster because of what you built.




Possess deep technical skills in Python and hands-on experience with cloud ML infrastructure like Databricks MLflow, AWS SageMaker or an equivalent.




Bring deep expertise in at least one ML domain we run in production: time-series forecasting, optimization algorithms or personalization at scale.




Think in platforms, not patches: you build repeatable workflows and you know how to onboard a team of experienced peers into them.




Handle ambiguity well and communicate complex data concepts clearly to product and engineering stakeholders.




Embrace LLM and agentic AI tools as part of how modern data science gets done.




Bonus: experience with energy time-series data, smart charging or grid optimization.




💆🏻 ♀️💆🏽 ♂️The Tibber Mindset

Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours - from electric vehicles to smart thermostats, all connected to the Tibber platform. We strengthen the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.




We win, fail, and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we're on a journey to make it central to everything we do. The further we go, the more our Tibberinos matter - and yes, that's what we call ourselves!




Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Oslo, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Førde. And we're still just getting started.




You're welcome at Tibber for who you are. We hire for what you can do and how you think - not your background or where you've been. Diverse teams build better products, and we mean that.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Digital Sales Personal Banking
Description:
Job ID: 5575

Would you like to empower business to unlock the potential of data? We are growing our team in Data, Digital Sales and Engagement (DDSE) Sweden. We are now looking for a Senior Data Scientist who can help us to utilise more data and insight to engage with customers in different interactions.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About Our Team

In Data, Digital Sales and Engagement (DDSE) we are a group of specialists in various fields: everything from digital marketing and content production to web analysis and data science. Collectively, we are responsible for engaging new and existing personal customers in digital channels and driving sales via online/mobile banking and nordea.se. We are building the omnichannel customer journey experience and for that we need to connect different data sources across our platforms and applications. Right product, right process, right message, right channel, at the right time for the right customer.

The role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

About This Opportunity

We are looking for a curious and driven Senior Data Scientist who will play a key role in implementing our omnichannel customer journey strategy. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively with stakeholders in Personal Banking. In this role, you will enable Digital Sales to leverage data and analytics to enhance the customer experience. You will deliver insights and recommendations, drive automation through model-based solutions, simplify processes, and identify new data sources. Together with the team, you will develop advanced AI models to predict customer needs and behaviours in digital channels.

In addition you will be:


Analysing how our omnichannel business is developing including e.g. sales, activity performance, customer behaviour, pricing, process steps and demand
Designing and developing customer engagement activities: suggest target group, evaluate data availability, support utilizing sufficient control groups, monitor the outcome of activities, and evaluate the results
Participating actively in the work of digital customer journey teams, training and coaching the team to utilize data & analytics
Enabling data for analytics, reporting and marketing automation tool(s)
Recommending and performing analysis of different data sources to spot development trends and pain points
Together with a wider data analyst community and take part into building analytics & tools needed for business development


Who You Are

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us.

We are looking for someone passionate about data and analytics, with the ability to turn data into insights, ideas and opportunities that support strong customer experiences. You take ownership of the full data science lifecycle—from data gathering and engineering to modelling—while keeping a clear business focus.

To succeed in this role, we believe that you are/have:


Interest in business and customer behaviour
Good at collaboration in practice - work closely with other Subject Matter Experts, involve stakeholders and always asking questions and investigating alternative solutions
Can drive tasks on your own but equally skilled in facilitating collaboration around tasks while maintaining the customer centric mindset
Innovative, openminded and excited about bringing your ideas to the table. You strive for continuous improvement and love learning and trying out new things. You're dependable, willing to speak up even when it's difficult, and committed to empowering others
A proactive, innovative and can-do oriented mind-set with the ability to convert new ideas into concrete actions, share “make it happen attitude”
A passion to share your knowledge and a ability to clearly communicate complex issues in an easy and understandable manner to a wide range of stakeholder


Your experience and background:


At least 3-5 years of experience in data analytics/data science
You are comfortable in using one or more data science programming language e.g. Python, R, SQL
You know your ways around tools like Hive, Snowflake, visualization tool such as Power BI
You understand the principles of working with an Agile development approach
Academic degree in highly quantitative discipline or specialisation such as Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or Finance, and you have understanding of statistical concepts (e.g. Hypothesis Testing) and machine learning models
Proficient in written and spoken Swedish and English


What We Offer

By joining Nordea you can impact on the life of 11 million customers. Our team has an important role in helping to inspire and educate business teams on effectively utilizing data to drive informed decision-making. Joining the team will provide you with opportunities to use your experience with data management, data analysis and data engineering to support business developers, leaders, digital marketing specialists & other stakeholders.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Please submit your application no later 16/08/2026. Remember that we don´t accept applications via email. Interviews will be held continuously. For more information about the position, you are more than welcome to contact Sebastian Kovacs, Head of PeB analytics SE, +46 76-8239114, Sebastian.kovacs@nordea.se.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Scania Asset Management
Description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Ventures and New Business at Scania have a key role in contributing to this vision. We drive the industry transformation: At Ventures and New Business we develop complementing solutions to our core and build new growth through ventures and investments. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Scania is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help shape how we understand, value, price, and manage electric vehicle assets over time.

This role is for someone who wants to own complex analytical problems, not only build models. You will work with imperfect operational data, commercial tradeoffs, and decisions that matter: residual value, pricing, lifecycle planning, asset risk, and long-term value creation.

Role Summary

You will join a small team with broad responsibilities and close contact with business, finance, product, engineering, and data colleagues. Your work will connect data science with real asset decisions, from assumptions and analysis to model services and recommendations that others can rely on.

Prior experience with electric vehicles, batteries, finance, fintech, pricing, risk, or asset valuation is valuable, but not required. We are looking primarily for seniority in judgement, ownership, and the ability to create clarity in complex problem areas.

Job Responsibilities



Develop models for battery-electric vehicle usage, remaining useful life, residual value, pricing, lifecycle forecasting, and portfolio risk.
Turn data such as mileage, energy usage, battery health, charging behavior, and asset value into clear decision support.
Define, test, and document assumptions around lifetime, degradation, refurbishment, second-life value, pricing, and risk exposure.
Improve, maintain, and operate deployed models and decision-support services used in real business decisions, including APIs, scheduled jobs, tests, monitoring, and versioning.
Communicate technical and financial reasoning clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.



Who You Are

You likely have:



Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience working across modelling, analysis, data quality, and production-quality code.
Experience building models that support business decisions, for example in pricing, risk, forecasting, asset valuation, lifecycle economics, finance, fintech, or portfolio analytics.
Cloud experience, including deploying or operating data products, APIs, scheduled jobs, model services, or similar workloads.
Demonstrated ownership from unclear business problem to model, data pipeline, deployment, adoption, and maintenance.
Strong self-leadership: you structure ambiguous work, make sound tradeoffs, challenge weak assumptions, and help raise the quality around you.
A Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science, economics, or a related discipline.



This Is Us

Everyone working at Scania is united by a common purpose: Driving the shift towards a sustainable transport system. We know that the transport industry must change, and it’s a change we want to lead. At Ventures and New business, we develop complementing solutions to our core and build new growth through ventures and investments that can accelerate us in driving the shift.People are core to our business. By joining our journey towards a sustainable transport system, you are contributing to the future of transport. You are part of a team that can create real change. At Ventures and New Business, we want to engage and inspire our full organization to create results together with us. Collaboration and entrepreneurial spirit is part of our culture and what makes us successful. By joining us you will be a part of driving meaningful growth in new ways!

Scania Offers

We offer you the chance to be part of an organization that is focused on reaching Scania’s targets and to truly drive the industry transformation. People who work here have the motivation and desire to constantly make things better.

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-31. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Aleksandra Kulpa, Talent Acquisition Specialist, aleksandra.x.kulpa@scania.com

Title: Senior/Lead Data Scientist- Open Banking
Description:
What You Will Do

As a Senior Data Scientist within our Open Banking team, you will build the analytical foundation that turns raw bank account data into reliable, actionable insight for fraud prevention and underwriting decisions. You will engage in feature engineering across incoming and outgoing cash flows to model affordability, and develop machine learning models that estimate probability of default and produce fraud scorecards. You will own the full lifecycle of these models, from raw data through to production deployment, working closely with engineering to operationalize your work at scale. You will also help monitor model performance, impact, and acceptance rates through dashboards you help build, and you will partner closely with the Credit Modeling and Fraud teams to align on shared goals and infrastructure.

Who You Are


Experience building and deploying machine learning models end to end, from raw data to production
Strong feature engineering skills, ideally with transactional or financial data
Proficient in Python and SQL, with experience working in AWS environments
Solid understanding of classification modeling techniques for risk or fraud use cases
Comfortable partnering closely with engineering teams to bring models into production
Strong communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with Credit Modeling and Fraud teams
A curious, ownership-driven mindset, comfortable building infrastructure and processes from scratch


Awesome to have


Experience with open banking data or affordability modeling
Familiarity with building dashboards for model monitoring, ideally with tools like Databricks
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog
Background in underwriting, credit risk, or fraud detection use cases


Please include a CV in English
